verdict.rationale: The Public API reference documents creating API tokens and includes Authentication sections titled "Scope" and "Permissions and security". That points to a first-party, scoped credential model for programmatic access, but the evidence is only a table-of-contents listing, so how granular or least-privilege those tokens can be is unproven. missing for 10: explicit documentation of per-token role or permission restrictions (e.g., read-only or resource-limited tokens), guidance on issuing narrowly scoped credentials for agents, token rotation and revocation details, and independent or hands-on corroboration.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can issue scoped/least-privilege API credentials for an agent
